title: The Structural Theorem of Capitalism: Full Structural Characterization, Public Replacement, and Joint Settlement

additional_titles.title: 资本主义的结构总定理：全形态刻画、公共替代与共同清算

description: This paper proves a structural theorem covering all forms of capitalism: the complete exclusion of capital relations has the absence of asymmetry in permissions as its minimal support; every actual capital relation can be reconstructed from its own evidence of production, dependence, and control, and can enter a common social contract for termination and continuation. Coverage comes from universal proofs over laws, constructor types, execution sequences, and actual histories. For any production sequence, public replay preserves the full successor state, actual physical quantities, provision for every member's living and maintenance needs, and task services, while eliminating capital control. From any point in an actual run, a disposition procedure produces either a witness of complete abolition or a specific obstruction within a finite number of steps determined by the current internal workload. Success jointly preserves members' independent execution, productive capacity, executable futures, and full-account non-loss for every person and good, together with a strict gain; failure retains the precise responsibility and an entry for continuation. Debt not represented at the financial entry appears as a specific matrix discrepancy. Mechanisms fixed before unknown events support paid local information, real risk settlement, and continuing innovation beyond the quoted menu; throughout any actual continuation, cumulative receipts for one contribution origin across all account positions cannot exceed its issued quantity. Complete responsibilities are carried through coalitions, open mechanisms, and institutional changes, without requiring the existing ledger to be finite. For settlement costs, a financial tail with sufficient resources has an actual optimum, while another complete settlement domain supplies a strictly cheaper complete settlement for every completing candidate. By distinguishing the grounds of basic participation, repayment for contributions, and continuing control, the paper connects these results to theories of production relations, property rights, innovation, and common governance. It shows how production can continue while domination ceases to acquire permanent standing from the necessity of its functions.

additional_descriptions.description: 本文证明资本主义全形态的结构总定理：资本关系的完整排除恰以权限无不对称为最小支撑；每一项实际资本关系都能由自身的生产、依赖与控制证据重构，并进入同一套社会终止与续行合同。覆盖来自对法则、构造类型、执行序列和实际历史的全称证明。对任意生产执行序列，公共重放保持完整后态、实际物量、全员生活维护及任务服务，同时消除资本控制。对实际运行的任意截点，处置程序在由当前内部工作量确定的有限步内，生成完整废止的见证或具体阻塞；成功共同保留成员的独立执行、生产能力、可执行未来及逐人逐物量的不损与严格增益，失败保留确切责任和继续入口。金融入口未表示的债务以具体矩阵差额显现。固定于未知事件之前的机制支持付费局部信息、真实风险结算及菜单之外的连续创新；任意实际续行中，同一贡献来源在全部账户位置的累计受领不超过其发行数量。完整责任又沿联盟、开放机制和制度变更承接，无须假定既有总账有限。清算成本方面，资源足额的财务尾段具有实际最优方案，另一个完整清算域则为任意完成候选构造成本更低的完整清算。本文以基础参与、贡献受偿与持续控制的理由分工，连接这些结果与生产关系、产权、创新和共同治理理论，说明生产如何继续，而支配不再因功能之必要而取得永久资格。

Bilingual manuscripts and technical supplements, plus editable source. The research source is fixed at df421ff600085cbc290a7ae946193961bed7c83b.
